verdict.rationale: Firecrawl is a hosted SaaS API, so a training opt-out or no-training data policy is a fair privacy question to ask. The evidence pack never mentions a training opt-out, a zero-retention option, or a no-training commitment. The server-side controls in the pack cover IP allowlists, per-key restrictions, URL blocking and audit events, none of which address model training, and the open-source/self-host mention is not framed as a training-data protection.
